name: razor-collect-imports-root-walk
body: RazorCompiler.CollectImports stops its ancestor walk only when it meets the root directory by exact, case-sensitive path comparison, so a Razor file outside its root, or a root whose casing differs from the file path's on a case-insensitive filesystem, walks up to the filesystem root and can apply imports from above the project. Upgrade if a caller can ever pass a file outside its root or differently-cased paths.
